title: SolveSpace NG review 4: keys and layout
brief: One round, eight questions, each picture once. For each row pick a, b, c (or d for the layout) as the question says, and add a note if you want it different. A complete answer is a letter on every row. Nothing is built yet; the research is in docs/research/keymap-and-layout.md. * in a table = not re-checked against that app's own list.

sheets.label: L1 layout
sheets.question: L1. Window layout (mock-ups cut from the app). a = now: Outliner left, Properties right, shelf on top. b = your idea: tool column + Outliner over Properties, all on the left. c = tool column left, Outliner over Properties on the right (Blender, SketchUp, Plasticity). d = Outliner over Properties left, tools along the top (FreeCAD, SOLIDWORKS). My pick: c (tools and panels on opposite sides, as every app with a tool column does).

sheets.label: K1 sketch keys
sheets.question: K1. Sketch tools on the industry letters: R rectangle, A arc, S spline; select all moves to Ctrl+A. a = yes, b = keep NG now, c = other (note).

sheets.label: K2 H/V vs hide
sheets.question: K2. H and V: a = horizontal / vertical (Onshape, FreeCAD, Classic), hiding moves to Onshape's Y / Shift+Y / Shift+I. b = keep Blender's H / Alt+H / Shift+H for hiding; horizontal and vertical stay in the F pie. My pick: a (constraining is far more frequent than hiding groups).

sheets.label: K3 constraints
sheets.question: K3. The other constraints on letters (column Proposed). a = all of them, b = only Onshape's I, B/T and M, c = none (F pie only, as now).

sheets.label: K4 construction
sheets.question: K4. X toggles construction (Fusion) and stops deleting; Backspace deletes (Onshape, Shapr3D). a = yes, b = keep T and X as now, c = other.

sheets.label: K5 groups
sheets.question: K5. Your Helix and Lathe question: no app binds them. a = Alt+R lathe (revolve all the way) and Alt+E helix (extrude while turning); patterns stay in the palette. b = no keys for them, c = other keys (note).

sheets.label: K6 views
sheets.question: K6. Views without a numpad: add Onshape's Shift+1..7 beside the numpad keys, and W looks at the active sketch. a = yes, b = numpad only, c = other (e.g. FreeCAD's bare digits; they clash with typed values).

sheets.label: V1 view menu
sheets.question: V1. Your note was 'View: rethink'. This is it after P3/P4 (Standard Views, Panels, View Settings, Light Theme). a = good, b = rethink further (note what you miss from other apps).
